integrity: All-n tree bounds follow analytically from majorization for positive contraction and a separate exact log-ratio inequality for negative contraction. The degree-three branch factor is an algebraic identity. Exhaustive finite Prüfer enumeration only corroborates the proof.
scientific_limitations: Extremizers refer only to Dutta's independent resource-qubit depolarization or phase damping between walk CZ and the measurement Hadamard, with ideal data, gates, and readout; targets are distinct n-vertex tree graph states. The degree-three criterion is necessary but not sufficient for native hardware mapping. No assertions about correlated device noise, arbitrary cyclic graphs, or device-optimal circuits.
title: Noise-induced reversal of tree-fidelity extremizers in distributed graph states
